title: Correct WIII completion state semantics
outOfScope: V1 snapshot behavior, scheduler/retry/cancellation behavior, sourceRef path validation, index publication/cache behavior, reducer persistence design, provider configuration, releases, tags, and historical archive rewrites.

sources.reason: The approved WIII V2 remediation design establishes the current-state completion boundary; the latest assessment refines its invalidation requirement.
Defines the V2 completion projection currently derived from historical fact presence.
Defines current WIII V2 unit behavior and regression conventions.
Publishes the WIII V2 completion contract for external agents.

riskAssessment.reason: A stale historical pass must never be exposed as current verification completion, while schema version 1 remains byte-compatible.

reasons: Public V2 protocol and persistent snapshots require the Standard profile.

executionDecision.reason: User authorized the full Work Item lifecycle and the source, scope, acceptance, and verification are explicit.

preReviewWarnings: Review invalidation ordering: a later verification failure must override an earlier pass without changing V1 output.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: V2 completion exposes each phase as a state object using only not_started, in_progress, completed, failed, invalidated, or unknown.
A verification_passed followed by verification_failed exposes verification.state=invalidated and identifies the pass fact and invalidating fact.
A later verification pass after invalidation returns verification.state=completed and points at that latest pass.
V1 output remains byte-compatible and V2 schema, unit tests, integration tests, and reference documentation describe the current-state semantics.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: V2 completion currently treats the historical appearance of verification_passed as completion even when a later verification_failed fact makes verification no longer valid. External agents that read only completion can therefore make an unsafe decision.
constraints: Completion is a V2 current-state projection, not a historical boolean.
The change remains repository-local and read-only; it adds no scheduler, retry, cancellation, provider, or network behavior.
Every state transition must be derived deterministically from ordered facts.
intent.rationale: Explicit phase states make invalidation observable and prevent stale positive evidence from being mistaken for current readiness.
